gen-mystery-quest-gf-pathway-extreme: Mystery Quest has jaws that gape open on every curve, a bookish, old-timey look in display form. Pathway Extreme settles underneath with rounded letters and stubby ascenders, so a long page of sans text feels modern and easy going.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-preahvihear: Preahvihear opens its letters like a pried oyster shell and stands on a lofty x-height, contemporary and wide-mouthed. Mystery Quest, the nostalgic display heading, gives it a bookish foil.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-pt-sans-caption: Nostalgic type meets a friendly workhorse. Mystery Quest keeps its curves gaping and its ascenders compact, while PT Sans Caption leaves its bowls unclosed and its lowercase big-bodied, so the heading and text feel like two voices in one room.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-puritan: Open jaws on every curve give Mystery Quest its bookish, old-fashioned bite. Puritan follows in plain sans, rounded and oversized in its e and a counters, which keeps the text approachable beneath that display heading.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-questrial: Old-book charm meets a fineliner. Mystery Quest bends its curves with gaping jaws and compact ascenders, and Questrial stays flat and single-weight below, its sans letters tall with short stalks.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-radio-canada: Nostalgic, with jaws wide open on every curve: that is Mystery Quest. Radio Canada runs below as a plain sans with tall, full c, s and z and a steady line, so paragraphs of text move along smoothly and clearly.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big fills the line with a tall x-height and a monoline skeleton, its terminals finishing clear of the stem. Mystery Quest is the bookish display heading, and Radio Canada Big stays flat along every curve where the heading gapes; a modest heading size should suit it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-readex-pro: Mystery Quest gapes open on every curve, bookish and nostalgic. Readex Pro takes over in plain sans, with broad terminal gaps and curves that never thin, so a long page of text moves along with an unvarying weight.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-roboto: Nostalgic through and through, Mystery Quest sets bookish display letters with compact ascenders. Roboto, clean and contemporary with generous mouths on its round letters, would overpower the heading if it were made large, so keep the heading up top.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-ruda: Mystery Quest cuts open jaws into every curved stroke, giving it a bookish, nostalgic bite. Ruda bends its letters from a single length of wire, a plain sans with a sizable x-height, so a long page feels approachable on screen.
